CustomField.description: True when the quote payment term is longer than the partner/account payment terms, or the account term is non-numeric; false when the quote term is Due Upon Receipt.
CustomField.formula:
IF( TEXT(Ruby__PaymentTerm__c) = "Due Upon Receipt", false, IF( AND(OR( ELV_PartnerPaymentTerms__c = "Cash with Order (CWO)", ELV_PartnerPaymentTerms__c = "Not Applicable", ELV_PartnerPaymentTerms__c = "None - Reseller only" ), TEXT(Ruby__PaymentTerm__c) <> "0"),
true, VALUE(SUBSTITUTE(TEXT(Ruby__PaymentTerm__c), "Net ", "")) > VALUE(SUBSTITUTE(ELV_PartnerPaymentTerms__c, "Net ", "")) ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Indicates whether quote payment terms exceed the partner/account standard.
CustomField.label: Quote Term Override Approval
